extracted.intended_audience: Reuters journalists and editorial staff (newsroom editors/reporters)
extracted.subtask_description: A newsroom handbook / style-and-standards guide for Reuters journalists covering legal, sourcing, privacy, investment and social media rules and best practice. It lists section-level standards reporters and editors must follow when producing news content.
